author: okami
text:
I have yet to dig deeper on QM, but I tell you my view on it.

I use to consider QM when the HH and LL just break a little the previous H and L. As I understand, and as I said, I can't talk too loudly about my QM knowledge, what a bullish QM does is:

1) to cheat the sellers with the LL, that inmediatly goes up, getting fuel for the way up. 2) to cheat the buyers with the HH, that inmediatly goes down, cleaning the supply zone of orders, and letting free way for the up movement. But the HH also tell us that the downtrend probably has finish

3) Then price go back to the next demand zone, from where goes up, completing the QM.

author: Oedipus99
text: I'm confused, okami. I appreciate the input but I don't really know what you mean.

author: okami
text:
Of course, I was trying to point out many things.

What I meant was that I would not qualify what you're showing as a QM, because the Higher High has gone too far away, on a unproportioned way respect of the rest of the QM. That was my impression when I show also this other chartyou shared. The LL is unproportioned to the rest of the QM.

But this oneI would consider a proper QM. It is proportioned. It makes a HH, but then a LL that shows the trend is changing. It has not a HH or LL that gets over a lot of previous H or L.

In the chart we are discussing, although, there is what I would consider a proper QM, as I signal the yellow HH, that just gets over the previous H, showing bull intentions. Then price came back to demand, and then shoots up.

So one of the interpretations we could do of a QM is that price is taking out orders on both sides with the HH and LL. Why? Because over the Highs and Lows there use to be clusters of orders. As breakout trading and SL over the Highs and Lows is one of the most extended ways of trading ("if resistance is broken, then buy, and put SL under the last low"), there use to be a lot of orders. This order positions are well known, so when price goes over a H or L they trigger a lot of orders. But what happen if price inmediately goes the other way? panic and SL triggering that add fuel to the movement. In this charts, a lot of sellers were trapped on the LL, that became buyers when their SL were triggered, adding fuel to the bull movement. At the same time the retail uninformed sellers were being the counterpart of the big money buyers, that need a lot of sellers to fulfill their orders. On this chart we could read that then price arrives to a Supply level, doing a HH. There were yet sell orders, so price came back to the next demand where the QM completed. When price did the HH it shows the bull strength, and consumed the few Sell orders that were left on the level. So the level was cleaned, and the sellers that were trapped on the LL that started triggering their SL, the way to the highs was ready, and as it happens, it shoots up.

IF explainswhat I'm trying to say much better than me. Read the first explanation slowly...I just did it and understand it much better than when I read it for the first time

Hope this clarify what I was trying to say. Please, ask anything you want, so I could focus better on what I'm not explaining well.

author: okami
text:
It's interesting what you are saying. Could be a conscious decision over all the time? How could a reaction eight years ago have some meaning today? Well, if it was decided it was cheap eight years ago, probably will be it also today. And a long term investor or a central bank that wants to buy at a certain point, could wait one year until prices came back to buy again. Not me, of course, that with a tiny account want to make a living, but for those that moves trillions, that decide the value of a currency, time is not as important...well this is just a theory. But if the market is fractal, as we could test when we see the same patterns on every TF, the same thing that is happening on the scalper tick chart is happening on the month chart...the same dynamics.

If it serves to you, my experience was that I didn't completely understand all the concepts when doing the homeworks...there were pieces of the puzzle that were lacking...there were the need of real time experimentation. Just keep working. Give it time if you don't completely get it, and start experiencing it on real time. The homeworks give you a fundation to start reading price and to meet some important concepts. You'll have time to came back and go deeper on it to fully understand every concept as QM or CP. I yet have to do it. Just keep going and points will start to connect.
